result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out, but one card image failed to load: the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section shows a gray placeholder box with a broken-image icon instead of a photo, while its sibling cards display images correctly. Other observations (partially visible carousel item at the right edge and the card cut off at the bottom viewport edge) are expected scroll behaviors and not defects.

issues.description: The hero image for the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section failed to load, showing a light gray placeholder area with a broken-image icon instead of the restaurant photo, while adjacent cards (e.g. the pizza card below) render images correctly.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image source/URL for this card and ensure the asset loads; add a graceful fallback (retry logic or a branded placeholder image) instead of the generic broken-image icon.

issues.description: The broken-image placeholder state uses a bare gray rectangle with a small icon, which looks visually unfinished compared to the rich imagery elsewhere on the page.
issues.suggestion: Design a more polished loading/error state (e.g. skeleton shimmer or themed placeholder illustration) so failed images do not appear as empty gray blocks.
